politique_en:
Investment objective
The fund invests primarily in global equity markets striving to build a diversified portfolio with a focus on theme, sector and stock selection. The exposure to the Emerging Markets is restricted to 50 % while convertible bonds may not exceed 15 % of the fund's assets. Its investment objective is to attain capital growth over the long term. Sustainability aspects are taken into account by the fund management. For more information on the investment strategy, the permissible asset classes and the sustainability approach, please refer to the sales prospectus.
